transcription.text: Finished with my woman 'cause she couldn't help me with my mind People think I am insane because I am frowning all the time All day long I think of things, but nothing seems to satisfy Think I'll lose my mind if I don't find something to pacify Can you help me? Help me find my brain? Oh yeah! I need someone to show me the things in life that I can't find I can't see the things that make true happiness, I must be blind Make a joke and I will sigh, and you will laugh, and I will cry Happiness I cannot feel and love to me is so unreal And so as you hear these words telling you now of my state I tell you to enjoy life, I wish I could, but it's too late
